Crate storage fee

A made-up sample tool. The regulation, the rates and the cap are invented for testing.

Source

Fee per crate by length of storage, and the cap on the total: Fictional Example Regulation 12, paragraph 12.3(b), revised 2024-03-01. Read the made-up source.

What this does not cover

Storage longer than 365 days, part crates, and refrigerated crates are out of scope.
